items.title: 12.2.2 Lim_{x->0} (sqrt(x+a) - sqrt(a))/x = 1/(2 sqrt(a)) where n is an integer and a > 0. (Roman Urdu)

blocks.text: Pichle sabaq mein \(\frac{0}{0}\) ka masla factorization se hal hua tha. Lekin jab function mein square roots (jazr) hon to factor banana mushkil ho jata hai. Is sabaq mein hum ek naya auzaar seekhenge: rationalization (conjugate se zarb de kar root hatana). Pehle kitab ka result, phir us ka saboot, phir kitab ki misaal.
Is section ka result yeh hai (sirf \(a > 0\) ki shart ke saath):

blocks.text_alt: limit as x approaches 0 of (square root of x plus a, minus square root of a) over x equals 1 over 2 times square root of a

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ki heading mein likha hai "where \(n\) is an integer and \(a > 0\)", lekin is limit mein \(n\) kahin hai hi nahin; yeh jumla ghalti se 12.2.1 ki heading se aa gaya hai. Sahi shart sirf \(a > 0\) hai. Heading mein "Lim" ke neeche ka arrow bhi ghalat chhapa hai; sahi \(x \to 0\) hai.

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text: Sab se pehle dekhte hain ke masla kya hai. \(x = 0\) rakhne se \(\frac{\sqrt{a}-\sqrt{a}}{0} = \frac{0}{0}\) aata hai. Yahan koi polynomial nahin jis ke factors banayein; masla square roots ka hai. Square roots ka ilaaj rationalization hai, bilkul waise hi jaise aap ne pichli classes mein \(\frac{1}{\sqrt{2}}\) ke denominator se root hataya tha.
Kitab kehti hai: \(x = 0\) rakhne se \(\left(\frac{0}{0}\right)\) form aati hai, is liye hum numerator ko rationalize karte hain:

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text:
Rationalize karne ka matlab hai numerator aur denominator dono ko conjugate (jora, yani wohi do terms magar beech ka sign ulta) \(\sqrt{x+a}+\sqrt{a}\) se zarb dena. Yeh asal mein 1 se zarb dena hai (\(\frac{\text{kuch}}{\text{wohi kuch}} = 1\)), is liye value nahin badalti, sirf shakal badalti hai.
Yeh kaam kyun karta hai? Is formula ki wajah se:
\[(A-B)(A+B) = A^{2}-B^{2}\]
\[(\sqrt{x+a}-\sqrt{a})(\sqrt{x+a}+\sqrt{a}) = (x+a) - a = x\]
Square karne se roots khatam ho jate hain, aur upar ek saaf suthra \(x\) aa jata hai jo neeche wale \(x\) se cancel ho jata hai. Yahi to humein chahiye tha!
Ab upar \((\sqrt{x+a}-\sqrt{a})(\sqrt{x+a}+\sqrt{a}) = x+a-a\) aur neeche \(x(\sqrt{x+a}+\sqrt{a})\) banta hai:

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab in do lines mein denominator ka \(x\) likhna bhool gayi hai: woh \(\frac{x+a-a}{\sqrt{x+a}+\sqrt{a}}\) aur \(\frac{x}{\sqrt{x+a}+\sqrt{a}}\) chhaapti hai. Zarb dene ke baad neeche \(x(\sqrt{x+a}+\sqrt{a})\) hota hai, jaise humne oopar likha. Yahi \(x\) upar wale \(x\) se cancel ho kar kitab ki agli line deta hai, aur aakhri jawab \(\frac{1}{2\sqrt{a}}\) sahi hai.
Ab \(x\) cancel karein aur phir \(x = 0\) rakhein:

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text:
\(x\) cancel karna jaiz kyun hai? Kyun ke \(x \to 0\) ka matlab hai \(x \ne 0\).
Cancel ke baad denominator \(\sqrt{x+a}+\sqrt{a}\) hai, jo \(x = 0\) par \(2\sqrt{a}\) banta hai. \(a > 0\) hai, is liye yeh zero nahin, aur substitution chal jata hai. Yahi wajah hai ke shart \(a > 0\) zaroori hai: \(a = 0\) hota to neeche phir zero aa jata.

blocks.title: Hamari taraf se misaal
blocks.text:
Yeh misaal humari taraf se hai: \(\lim_{x\to 0}\frac{\sqrt{x+4}-2}{x}\).
Pehchaaniye: \(2 = \sqrt{4}\), to yeh bilkul isi result ki shakal hai, \(a = 4\) ke saath.
\[\lim_{x\to 0}\dfrac{\sqrt{x+4}-\sqrt{4}}{x} = \dfrac{1}{2\sqrt{4}} = \dfrac{1}{4}\]
Ab kitab ki misaal dekhte hain. Is mein ek part factorization ka hai aur ek part roots ka, yani dono auzaar istemal honge.

blocks.title: Example 1
steps:
Given: (i) \(\frac{x^{2}-1}{x^{2}-x}\) jab \(x \to 1\); (ii) \(\frac{x-3}{\sqrt{x}-\sqrt{3}}\) jab \(x \to 3\).
To find: dono limits.
Method: sab se pehle hum dekhte hain ke substitution se kya milta hai. Dono parts mein \(\frac{0}{0}\) aata hai. Part (i) mein factors bana kar common factor \((x-1)\) cancel karenge. Part (ii) mein \(x - 3\) ko \(\sqrt{x}\) aur \(\sqrt{3}\) ke squares ke farq ki shakal mein likh kar \((\sqrt{x}-\sqrt{3})\) cancel karenge.

(i) Step 1: Pehle substitution try karein
\[\dfrac{1^{2}-1}{1^{2}-1} = \dfrac{0}{0}\]
Kyun: har limit ke sawal mein pehla qadam substitution hai. Yahan \(\left(\frac{0}{0}\right)\) form aayi, yani seedha jawab nahin mila. Is liye function ko simplify karna hoga.

(i) Step 2: Factors banayein aur cancel karein
\[\lim_{x\to 1}\dfrac{x^{2}-1}{x^{2}-x} = \lim_{x\to 1}\dfrac{(x-1)(x+1)}{x(x-1)}\]
\[= \lim_{x\to 1}\dfrac{x+1}{x}\]
Kyun: \(x^{2}-1\) do squares ka farq hai, \((x-1)(x+1)\). Aur \(x^{2}-x\) mein \(x\) common hai, \(x(x-1)\). Ab dekhiye, factor \((x-1)\) upar bhi hai aur neeche bhi; yahi \(x = 1\) par zero ban kar \(\frac{0}{0}\) paida kar raha tha. Limit lete waqt \(x \ne 1\), is liye yeh zero nahin aur cancel ho sakta hai.

(i) Step 3: Ab number rakhein
\[\lim_{x\to 1}\dfrac{x+1}{x} = \dfrac{1+1}{1} = \dfrac{2}{1} = 2\]
Kyun: cancel karne ke baad denominator \(x = 1\) par zero nahin rehta, is liye ab substitution kaam karta hai.

(ii) Step 1: Pehle substitution try karein
\[\dfrac{3-3}{\sqrt{3}-\sqrt{3}} = \dfrac{0}{0}\]
Kyun: phir \(\left(\frac{0}{0}\right)\) form, to simplify karna parega.

(ii) Step 2: \(x - 3\) ko squares ke farq ki shakal dein
\[x - 3 = (\sqrt{x})^{2} - (\sqrt{3})^{2}\]
\[= (\sqrt{x}+\sqrt{3})(\sqrt{x}-\sqrt{3})\]
Kyun: yeh is sawal ki chaabi hai. \(x > 0\) ke liye \(x = (\sqrt{x})^{2}\) aur \(3 = (\sqrt{3})^{2}\). To \(x - 3\) asal mein do squares ka farq hai, aur \(a^{2}-b^{2} = (a+b)(a-b)\) lag jata hai. Is se wohi factor ban jata hai jo denominator mein hai. Pehli nazar mein \(x - 3\) ke factors nazar nahin aate, lekin root wali soch se aa jate hain.

(ii) Step 3: Cancel karein aur number rakhein
\[\lim_{x\to 3}\dfrac{x-3}{\sqrt{x}-\sqrt{3}}\]
\[= \lim_{x\to 3}\dfrac{(\sqrt{x}+\sqrt{3})(\sqrt{x}-\sqrt{3})}{\sqrt{x}-\sqrt{3}}\]
\[= \lim_{x\to 3}(\sqrt{x}+\sqrt{3})\]
\[= \sqrt{3}+\sqrt{3} = 2\sqrt{3}\]
Kyun: \(x \to 3\) ka matlab \(x \ne 3\), is liye \(\sqrt{x}-\sqrt{3} \ne 0\) aur cancel ho jata hai. Jo bacha, \(\sqrt{x}+\sqrt{3}\), woh \(x = 3\) par aaram se calculate hota hai.

Tasdeeq:
(i) \(x = 1.001\) le kar dekhein: \(\frac{x+1}{x} = \frac{2.001}{1.001} \approx 1.999\), jo 2 ke bohat qareeb hai.
(ii) Doosre tareeqe se bhi yahi jawab aata hai: upar neeche \(\sqrt{x}+\sqrt{3}\) se zarb dein (rationalization). Neeche \(x - 3\) ban jata hai jo upar wale \(x - 3\) se cancel hota hai, aur \(\sqrt{x}+\sqrt{3} \to 2\sqrt{3}\) bachta hai. Dono tareeqe ek hi jawab dete hain.

blocks.title: Khud sochiye
blocks.text:
\(\lim_{x\to 4}\frac{x-4}{\sqrt{x}-2}\) kitni hogi?
Jawab: \(x - 4 = (\sqrt{x}+2)(\sqrt{x}-2)\), cancel karne ke baad \(\sqrt{x}+2 \to 2+2 = 4\).

blocks.title: Exam tip
blocks.text: Jab square root ki wajah se \(\frac{0}{0}\) aaye to do raaste hain: conjugate se zarb dein (rationalize), ya Example 1 (ii) ki tarah doosri term ko squares ke farq ki shakal dein. Dono se same jawab aata hai; jo chhota lage woh chunein, magar har line likhein. Conjugate se zarb dete waqt upar aur neeche dono ko zarb dena likh kar dikhayein.

blocks.title: Yaad rakhne wali baatein
blocks.text:
1. \(\lim_{x\to 0}\frac{\sqrt{x+a}-\sqrt{a}}{x} = \frac{1}{2\sqrt{a}}\), jahan \(a > 0\).
2. Roots ki wajah se \(\frac{0}{0}\): conjugate se rationalize karo, \((A-B)(A+B) = A^{2}-B^{2}\).
3. Polynomials ki wajah se \(\frac{0}{0}\): factorize karo aur woh factor cancel karo jo us point par zero hota hai.
4. Cancel karna isliye jaiz hai ke limit mein \(x\) us point ke barabar kabhi nahin hota.

blocks.title: Aam ghaltiyan
blocks.text:
1. Sirf numerator ko conjugate se zarb dena. Upar aur neeche dono ko zarb dein, warna value badal jati hai.
2. \(\sqrt{x+a} = \sqrt{x}+\sqrt{a}\) likh dena. Yeh ghalat hai: \(\sqrt{9+16} = \sqrt{25} = 5\), jab ke \(\sqrt{9}+\sqrt{16} = 3+4 = 7\).
3. Zarb ke baad denominator ka \(x\) kho dena, jis se cancel karne ko kuch nahin bachta (jaisa kitab ki chhapi hui lines mein hua).
